description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git worktree prune' functionality. It contains multiple test cases that verify the behavior of pruning worktrees in various scenarios, such as invalid directories, unreadable gitdirs, locked checkouts, recent checkouts, duplicates, and relative path checkouts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A macro or function used to define a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: A macro or function that asserts the command within it must fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that the specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks that the specified path is a directory.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks that the output contains a specific pattern.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after the test.
